title: Drone Flight Controller
description: Stability control system for quadcopters based on a 6-axis IMU, implementing complementary filters and complex PID loops.
materials:
• Sensor Fusion: Complementary filter for precise attitude estimation
• Frequency: 1kHz control loop frequency for high-speed responsiveness
• Telemetry: Real-time radio link for flight monitoring and debugging
results: Successfully achieved stable hovering even under moderate wind conditions, validating the PID gain parameters and the efficiency of the IMU data processing pipeline.
